statements.statement: The service billed was mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229)
The denial reason code was CO-197
The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The patient has underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The indication is to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential atrial fibrillation or other rhythm disturbances
The concern is that rhythm disturbances may increase stroke risk
